_comment: Stage-0 input for scripts/parallel-shard-runner.js --serial-config. tests/run-all-shard.js reads this file only when TEST_SHARD_PARALLELISM is 2 or more (never in contract mode); the workflow leaves that variable at 1 unless the repository variable TEST_SHARD_PARALLELISM_J is set. 'serial' commands run alone, before the parallel phase. 'reviewedSafe' records audit hits (node scripts/parallel-shard-runner.js --shard X --audit) that were read and judged harmless for parallel execution. The audit is a heuristic text scan, not a proof. 'parallelEnabledShards' lists the only shards tests/run-all-shard.js may run in parallel when TEST_SHARD_PARALLELISM is set (anything else runs serially with a warning). 'timings' (seconds, from an idle 4-core run) order longest-first scheduling.
